text: Hello everyone, welcome to Daisy's class.Today we are going to review how to deal with the information we hear.During the lesson, you'll get a chance to review three common ways for getting the exact information and getting the general idea of what you hear by completing several listening tasks.Hopefully your listening ability will be improved.Please get your pen and the worksheet ready.Let's get started.What do you usually do when you want the exact information of what you hear?When you can get the information directly from what you hear.Or when you have to find out the general idea of what you hear.Actually we've already learned some ways to deal with these situations.Now we will mainly review three of them.Let's see what they are through practice.First, listen to the conversation and answer the question.You can find the task on your worksheet.There are three conversations for you.You'll hear each conversation only once.Take notes if necessary while listening.Ready?I found a really nice blue one, but I couldn't afford it.Then I found a nice green one that fits me.Number two.What do you usually do at weekends?I sometimes go to the park with my parents.Last week we visited my grandpa.Are you going to see your grandpa this weekend?No, my parents will go shopping, so I'll play basketball with my friends.Last one.Let's drive to the supermarket today.But my car is being repaired.Can we go there by taxi or by bike?Well, it's not very far.We can walk there.Okay, have you got all the answers?Let's check.Number one.We heard three colors.Yes, red, blue, green.What color is the right answer?Excellent, green.What about the other two?Yes, only very big ones left.And what about blue?Very good.He couldn't afford too expensive.There are many verb phrases in different tenses involved in the conversation.What are they?Yes, go to the park with parents, visited grandpa, will go shopping, will play basketball.Pay attention to the question.The question is about future action.And parents will go shopping, not the boy.So the right answer is the boy is going to play basketball with friends this weekend.Got it?Number three.What ways of traveling did you hear?Yeah, several ways, right?Drive to, by taxi or by bike.Yes, one more.Walk.And how can you figure out the right way?Very, very good.You caught the key words.Car is being repaired.And yes, not very far.So they will go to the supermarket.Yeah, this is the correct answer.They will walk to the supermarket.Well, to get the exact information while you are listening, selecting information really works.Selecting information is a way to remove the information you don't want according to the question you hear.Think about, what if you can't get the information directly?In that case, processing information is necessary.Here, processing information means加工信息.Processing information is a way to work out right answers with the given information.Let's see how it works.We often hear information related to numbers.Can you give some examples?Great.We often hear time, cost, price, address, telephone number, quantity, date.Distance and so on.Sometimes we need to process it just like doing an easy math exercise.Please move on to task two.Another five conversations for you to practice.You'll hear them only once.Listen very carefully and take notes if necessary.Excuse me, what time is the next flight to Beijing?It should leave at a quarter past ten in the morning, but it's an hour late today.Excuse me, how much is the new bicycle?It was 1800 yuan yesterday, but today it's 400 yuan cheaper.Mike, I hear you finished your report on public transportation of this city.Could you please tell me how many streets there are in the city?Sure.There used to be 150 streets in the city.This year, another seven streets have been completed.It's ten o'clock now.It's time to go to bed.Oh, can I stay for another twenty minutes, Mum?The concert will finish in ten minutes.Alright, let's check.Number one, in the conversation, the woman said it should leave at a quarter past ten, but it is an hour late.So the correct answer is the plane to Beijing will leave at eleven fifteen, a quarter past eleven.Number two, have you got what the shop assistant said?It was how much yesterday?1800 yuan, but now it is 400 yuan cheaper.So today the bicycle only costs 1400 yuan.Get it?Now let's move on to number three.Did you notice the speaker made a comparison?Oh yes, really good.There used to be this year.There used to be how many streets?Good.150 streets.This year, you just got part of the sentence.No problem.This year, another seven have been completed.So in the city, now there are 157 streets.Number four, in the conversation, Mum saidSo what's the time?Good, it's ten o'clock, but the boy wanted to stay for another twenty minutes.So the time when the boy will go to bed is ten twenty.Let's move on to the last one, number five.Usually we use how long to ask for a period of time.From the conversation, we learned it is open from nine a.to six p.on weekdays,and till eight p.at weekends.The question is about Saturday.So from nine a.to eight p., how many hours?Great, eleven hours.Have you got all the answers right?Through practice, we've learned while processing information, we should focus on expressions like should, but, to, but, used to be, now.In our late, only twenty minutes left, ten minutes earlier, in fifteen minutes, cheaper, until, or till.We should also write down the numbers we hear quickly,and do simple calculations like plus or minus.So far, you've worked very hard and reviewed two practical ways.Now let's move on to the last one.Sometimes you are asked to get the general idea of what you hear.For example, you are asked to get what the conversation is about or what a passage is mainly about.In that case,Combining information is helpful.Combining information is a way to gather details for generalizing.Here, generalize means 概括。Well, let's see how it works while you are listening to a passage.Please look at task three.You've got one or one and a half minutes to read all the questions.By the way, take notes while listening.You'll hear the passage twice.No, he wasn't caught at that time.Last one, maybe the easiest one, seven years.Have you got all the answers?Write down something if you missed on your worksheet.Pay attention to the words in red.A burglar, one of the first criminals, only stole a boar, touched a wet paint and left a clear fingerprint.Seven years.With the details you got, you can tell the story is mainly about this one, how technology helped the police catch Harry Jackson, or the experience of Harry Jackson, an unlucky burglar.Which one do you choose?Oh, great.The second one, the first one, just partly about, not mainly about.You can write down the answer on your worksheet.In today's lesson, we've reviewed three common ways to deal with the information we hear.To get the exact information, we can use selecting and processing.Combining information is helpful to get the general idea of what we hear.What's more, it is also helpful to make inferences.We'll talk about it later.Well, so much for today.Here's the homework.If possible, play a game called listen and repeat with a partner online.Take turns to read time, dates, or telephone numbers.Repeat what you hear as quickly as possible.After five rounds, the one who makes the fewest mistakes wins.You can also find it on your homework sheet.Have a nice day.See you.
